learning_store.signature: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')
learning_store.symptom: Component crashes during render when attempting to iterate over props or state data that hasn't arrived yet from an async fetch.
learning_store.root_cause: The variable passed to .map() is initialized as undefined or null before the asynchronous fetch promise resolves, or the API response returned an object with a nested array instead of a direct array.
learning_store.treatment: Use optional chaining with a default empty array fallback: (items || []).map(...) or items?.map(...), and ensure initial state is an empty array useState([]).
learning_store.prevention: 1. Define rigorous TypeScript interfaces for API payloads. 2. Initialize list state with [] instead of null/undefined. 3. Implement an explicit loading boundary or Skeleton before mapping data.

learning_store.signature: Route handler cookies() should be awaited in Next.js 15
learning_store.symptom: Calling const cookieStore = cookies() throws a synchronous access runtime warning or error in Next.js 15.
learning_store.root_cause: In Next.js 15, dynamic APIs like cookies(), headers(), and params became asynchronous Promises to allow internal performance optimizations and early streaming.
learning_store.treatment: Await the cookies() call inside the async function: const cookieStore = await cookies();
learning_store.prevention: When upgrading to Next.js 15+, run `npx @next/codemod@canary next-async-request-api .` to automatically upgrade all synchronous request-specific APIs.

learning_store.signature: RuntimeError: Event loop is closed in asyncio Python
learning_store.symptom: Python script fails at exit or during connection cleanup with RuntimeError: Event loop is closed when using asyncio.run() or aiohttp ClientSession.
learning_store.root_cause: Async resources (like aiohttp.ClientSession or database connection pools) were closed after the event loop finished or the Windows selector loop shut down ungracefully.
learning_store.treatment: Ensure all client sessions and connectors are closed inside an async with context manager BEFORE the loop exits, or add asyncio.sleep(0.25) before loop shutdown to allow pending SSL transports to flush.
learning_store.code_patch:
# Before:
session = aiohttp.ClientSession()
# ... async code without closing

# After (Surgical Treatment):
async def main():
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        async with session.get('https://api.example.com') as resp:
            return await resp.json()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
learning_store.prevention: Always wrap network and database clients inside async context managers (async with) so cleanup hooks execute while the event loop is active.

learning_store.symptom: Docker container fails during npm install or volume mount with EACCES: permission denied.
learning_store.root_cause: Host volume mount overwrites container file ownership with root permissions, while the container runs as unprivileged user 'node', preventing directory creation.
learning_store.treatment: In your Dockerfile, create the directory and set ownership to node user before USER node: RUN mkdir -p /app/node_modules && chown -R node:node /app
learning_store.code_patch:
# Before:
USER node
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install

# After (Surgical Treatment):
WORKDIR /app
RUN mkdir -p /app/node_modules && chown -R node:node /app
USER node
COPY --chown=node:node package*.json ./
RUN npm install
learning_store.prevention: Use named volumes for node_modules in docker-compose.yml: `volumes: [ .:/app, /app/node_modules ]` to prevent host directory ownership bleeding into container.

searchResults.snippet: The server can only send instructions (via Set-Cookie headers) to tell the browser to store cookies - the actual storage happens on the client side. This is why cookie operations that modify state (.set, .delete) must be performed in a Server Function or Route Handler where the response headers can be properly set.
